The list comprehension syntax was incorrect, so I will recompute every library playlist’s exact total duration in seconds and retain all 23 candidates.

```python
library_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    playlist_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not playlist_page:
        break
    library_playlists.extend(playlist_page)
    page_index += 1
playlist_durations = [
    (playlist['title'], int(sum(song['duration'] for song in playlist['songs']) * 1000))
    for playlist in library_playlists
]
print(playlist_durations)
```
